title: Parse host-sent fingerprint fields as SHA-256 fingerprints, not with the record-id parser
outcome: Parse host-sent fingerprint fields as SHA-256 fingerprints, not with the record-id parser
acceptance: Every fingerprint field the host protocol accepts (intent_fingerprint and the other fingerprint fields currently typed ObjectId) is parsed by one fingerprint validator that accepts only 64 lowercase hex characters. A 32-hex value in such a field is refused with a typed refusal, and nothing is recorded.
Record-id fields keep accepting 32 or 64 lowercase hex characters, and no stored record is reread or rewritten.
Before landing, current TermAl traffic is confirmed from TermAl source to send 64-hex values in every tightened field; tests cover the accepted and the refused case for each field.
